mustFix.problem: Alt text contains Wikimedia metadata unrelated to actual image content. Line 1332 says 'HTSSystems HTS-30DTF-2 Ultra-Rack units' for a dolly/ramp scene. Line 1333 says 'Nude man walking and carrying a 75 lb. stone' for hands-carrying-box. Line 1335 references 'Historic Route 66 near Amboy, California' for a hand-truck photo. Line 1336 references 'LINK spacecraft at NASA Wallops' for hero-B1. Screen reader users receive misleading information.
mustFix.fix: Rewrite each alt attribute to describe the actual visual content of the frame. For line 1332: 'Moving dolly loaded with boxed items being pushed up a metal ramp into a truck'. For line 1333: 'Two hands gripping a cardboard moving box from below, carrying it at waist height'. For line 1335: 'Metal hand truck with strapped boxes standing upright on a concrete surface'. For line 1336: describe what hero-B1 actually shows. Update data-fallback attributes to match.

mustFix.problem: 404 error on an unnamed resource. Missing assets break polish and may affect accessibility.
mustFix.fix: Identify the failing URL via browser Network tab or build logging, restore the missing file or remove the reference. Re-run check-render to confirm zero console errors.

elevate.move: Commission or art-direct a single move-day photo sequence shot in consistent warm light -- tag close-up, wrap station, ramp load, hallway carry, placed-in-room -- so crops tell a narrative arc and every frame reads as one shoot, eliminating the metadata-alt-text problem at its root.

Break the three-light-tone run by making the process story section t-deep with reversed text, creating a paper/deep/paper/deep rhythm that gives the scroll a visible loud-quiet-loud shape and separates the process narrative from the services grid.
